title: Robbing the music: Big Eye Louis and Bunk versus Robichaux's readers
summary: Non-readers like Big Eye Louis and Bunk rearranged note values by feel, whereas Robichaux's orchestra played what was written; Barnes prefers small bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

They like the band that's chopping up?
